description: Routes à Grande Circulation (RGC) sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de la Voirie - Services généraux Patrimoine. Extrait de l'Article L110-3 du Code de la Route: "les routes à grande circulation, quelle que soit leur appartenance domaniale, sont les routes qui permettent d'assurer la continuité des itinéraires principaux et, notamment, le délestage du trafic, la circulation des transports exceptionnels, des convois et des transports militaires et la desserte économique du territoire, et ... Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are route à grande circulation. The portal shows 65 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-04-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
